image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a metallic green tiger beetle perched on a textured, light-brown organic surface (likely a leaf or petal). The beetle displays iridescent coloration with distinct pale markings on its wing covers. Its head features large compound eyes and long, thread-like antennae. Several slender legs are visible gripping the surface.
